tools.name: netlify-user-services-reader
tools.description: Read the authenticated Netlify user's details.

tools.name: netlify-team-services-reader
tools.description: Read Netlify teams, a single team's details, and a team's environment variables.

tools.name: netlify-deploy-services-reader
tools.description: Read Netlify deploys: a deploy by id, or the deploys of a site.

tools.name: netlify-deploy-services-updater
tools.description: Deploy a Netlify site, including remote deploys from a project directory.

tools.name: netlify-project-services-reader
tools.description: Read Netlify projects: list projects, get one project, read its forms and form submissions.

tools.name: netlify-project-services-updater
tools.description: Change Netlify projects: create a project, rename it, update visitor access controls, forms and form submissions, and manage environment variables and secrets.

tools.name: netlify-extension-services-reader
tools.description: Read the Netlify extensions available to a team and the full details of one extension.

tools.name: netlify-extension-services-updater
tools.description: Install or uninstall a Netlify extension, and initialize a Netlify database.
